I am trying to determine whether mathlib already contains the following lemmas about monotone functions with a right inverse. If not, I would like to know whether they are suitable additions to mathlib.

I found that Function.monotoneOn_of_rightInvOn_of_mapsTo is closely related to the second statement below.
#MWE

section

variable {α β : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [Preorder β]

example {f : α -> β} {g : β -> α}
    (hf : StrictMono f) (hg : Function.RightInverse g f) :
    StrictMono g := by
  intro y₁ y₂ hy
  rw [← hf.lt_iff_lt, hg, hg]
  exact hy

end

section

variable {α β : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [PartialOrder β]

example {f : α → β} {g : β → α}
    (hf : Monotone f) (hg : Function.RightInverse g f) :
    Monotone g := by
  intro y₁ y₂ hy
  by_contra! nh
  grind [hf nh.le]

end

section

variable {α β : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β]
variable [TopologicalSpace α] [OrderTopology α] [ConnectedSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderTopology β] [OrderClosedTopology β]

example
  {f : α → β} {g : β → α} (hf1 : Continuous f) (hf2 : StrictMono f)
  (hg : Function.RightInverse g f) : ContinuousOn g (Set.range f) := by {
  set f' : α ≃o Set.range f :=
    StrictMono.orderIsoOfRightInverse
      (λ x => (⟨f x, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩ : Set.range f))
      (λ x y => by simp [hf2.lt_iff_lt])
      (λ y => g y)
      (by grind)
  have : Continuous f'.symm := by {
    haveI : (Set.range f).OrdConnected := isConnected_range hf1 |>.isPreconnected.ordConnected
    exact f'.symm.continuous
  }
  rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
  apply continuous_congr ?_ |>.mp this
  rintro -; rfl
}

  {f : α → β} {g : β → α}
  (hf1 : ContinuousOn f s)

variable {α β : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [Preorder β]
example {f : α → β} {g : β → α} (hf : StrictMono f) (hg : Function.RightInverse g f) :

As you mentioned:

import Mathlib
variable {α β : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [PartialOrder β]
example {f : α → β} {g : β → α} (hf : Monotone f) (hg : Function.RightInverse g f) :
    Monotone g :=
  monotoneOn_univ.mp <| Function.monotoneOn_of_rightInvOn_of_mapsTo
    (hf.monotoneOn _) (hg.rightInvOn _) (Set.mapsTo_univ _ _)

For these two: I think they are good to have, if only for discoverability
Can the first one have a StrictMonoOn + RightInvOn version like the second one has?
Thanks! I opened a PR here (#41388) adding strictMonoOn_of_rightInvOn_of_mapsTo as a strict version analogue of monotoneOn_of_rightInvOn_of_mapsTo.

I finished the last example (adding missing condition). Can we add these two to mathlib? 

import Mathlib

section

variable {α β : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β]
variable [TopologicalSpace α] [OrderTopology α] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderTopology β] [OrderClosedTopology β]

theorem theorem_name {s : Set α} {t : Set β}
    {f : α → β} {g : β → α}
    (hs : IsPreconnected s) (hf1 : ContinuousOn f s) (hf2 : StrictMonoOn f s)
    (hg : Set.RightInvOn g f t) (hf3 : Set.MapsTo f s t) (hg2 : Set.MapsTo g t s) : ContinuousOn g (f '' s) := by {
  have hs' : IsPreconnected (f '' s) := hs.image f hf1
  haveI : (f '' s).OrdConnected := hs'.ordConnected
  haveI : s.OrdConnected := hs.ordConnected
  set e : s ≃o f '' s := hf2.orderIso f s
  have hcont : Continuous e.symm := e.symm.continuous
  rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
  have heq : (f '' s).restrict g = fun y => (e.symm y : α) := by
    ext y
    rcases y with ⟨y, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩
    rw [e.symm_apply_eq.mpr (show _ = e ⟨x, hx⟩ from ?_)]
    · simp [← hf2.eq_iff_eq (hg2 <| hf3 hx) hx, hg (hf3 hx)]
    · rfl
  exact heq.symm ▸ continuous_subtype_val.comp hcont
}

example [PreconnectedSpace α]
  {f : α → β} {g : β → α}
  (hf1 : Continuous f) (hf2 : StrictMono f)
  (hg : Function.RightInverse g f) : ContinuousOn g (Set.range f) :=
  Set.image_univ ▸ theorem_name
    isPreconnected_univ hf1.continuousOn (hf2.strictMonoOn _)
    (hg.rightInvOn _) (Set.mapsTo_range f _) (Set.mapsTo_univ g _)

--  old proof
example [ConnectedSpace α]
  {f : α → β} {g : β → α}
  (hf1 : Continuous f)
  (hf2 : StrictMono f)
  (hg : Function.RightInverse g f) : ContinuousOn g (Set.range f) := by {
  set e : α ≃o Set.range f := hf2.orderIso
  haveI : (Set.range f).OrdConnected := isConnected_range hf1 |>.isPreconnected.ordConnected
  have : Continuous e.symm := e.symm.continuous
  rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
  apply continuous_congr ?_ |>.mp this
  rintro ⟨_, x, rfl⟩
  rw [e.symm_apply_eq.mpr (show _ = e x from ?_)]
  · simp [← hf2.injective.eq_iff, hg.eq]
  rfl
}

end
